It returns <math id="S3.I4.i2.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="c^{\prime}" display="inline"><msup><mi>c</mi><mo>′</mo></msup></math>, the commitment to the sequence <math id="S3.I4.i2.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="[(m_{1},r_{1}),(m_{2},r2),...,(m_{n},r_{n}),(m^{\prime},r^{\prime})]" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>m</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>r</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>m</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>r</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>m</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>m</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>r</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></math>.</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</section>
</section>
</section>
<section id="S4" class="ltx_section">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_section">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_section">4 </span>Fully private asset transfer (FPAT)</h2>

<section id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1" class="ltx_subparagraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subparagraph">State and interface.</h4>

<div id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">At the abstract level, the state of the FPAT object is represented as an array of <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="U" display="inline"><mi>U</mi></math> positive integer values <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="[v_{k}]_{k=1}^{U}" display="inline"><msubsup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msub><mi>v</mi><mi>k</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>U</mi></msubsup></math>, one for each user, interpreted as the current balances of the users’ accounts.
Let <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="[v^{init}_{k}]_{k=1}^{U}" display="inline"><msubsup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msubsup><mi>v</mi><mi>k</mi><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>i</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>t</mi></mrow></msubsup><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>U</mi></msubsup></math> be the <em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">initial state</em> of the object.
The object exports two operations: <span class="ltx_text ltx_markedasmath ltx_font_italic">transfer</span> and <span class="ltx_text ltx_markedasmath ltx_font_italic">balance</span>.
Assuming that a user <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="u" display="inline"><mi>u</mi></math> invokes an operation, they are defined as follows:</p>
<ul id="S4.I1" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="S4.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"><math id="S4.I1.i1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\blacksquare" display="inline"><mi mathvariant="normal">■</mi></math></span> 
<div id="S4.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p"><math id="S4.I1.i1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\textit{transfer}_{u}(v,w)/r" display="inline"><mrow><mrow><msub><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_italic">transfer</mtext><mi>u</mi></msub><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>w</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>/</mo><mi>r</mi></mrow></math> takes as inputs a value <math id="S4.I1.i1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="v" display="inline"><mi>v</mi></math> and a user identifier <math id="S4.I1.i1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="w" display="inline"><mi>w</mi></math>. It transfers the amount <math id="S4.I1.i1.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="v" display="inline"><mi>v</mi></math> from <math id="S4.I1.i1.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="u" display="inline"><mi>u</mi></math> to <math id="S4.I1.i1.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="w" display="inline"><mi>w</mi></math>: updates a state <math id="S4.I1.i1.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="[v_{k}]_{k=1}^{U}" display="inline"><msubsup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msub><mi>v</mi><mi>k</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>U</mi></msubsup></math> to the state <math id="S4.I1.i1.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="[v_{k}^{\prime}]_{k=1}^{U}" display="inline"><msubsup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msubsup><mi>v</mi><mi>k</mi><mo>′</mo></msubsup><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>U</mi></msubsup></math> where <math id="S4.I1.i1.p1.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="v_{k}^{\prime}=v_{k}+v" display="inline"><mrow><msubsup><mi>v</mi><mi>k</mi><mo>′</mo></msubsup><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>v</mi><mi>k</mi></msub><mo>+</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow></mrow></math> if <math id="S4.I1.i1.p1.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="k=w\wedge u\neq w" display="inline"><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>w</mi><mo>∧</mo><mi>u</mi></mrow><mo>≠</mo><mi>w</mi></mrow></math>, <math id="S4.I1.i1.p1.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="v_{k}^{\prime}=v_{k}-v" display="inline"><mrow><msubsup><mi>v</mi><mi>k</mi><mo>′</mo></msubsup><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>v</mi><mi>k</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow></mrow></math> if <math id="S4.I1.i1.p1.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="k=u\wedge u\neq w" display="inline"><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>u</mi><mo>∧</mo><mi>u</mi></mrow><mo>≠</mo><mi>w</mi></mrow></math> and <math id="S4.I1.i1.p1.m13" class="ltx_Math" alttext="v_{k}^{\prime}=v_{k}" display="inline"><mrow><msubsup><mi>v</mi><mi>k</mi><mo>′</mo></msubsup><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>v</mi><mi>k</mi></msub></mrow></math> otherwise. It returns a binary response <math id="S4.I1.i1.p1.m14" class="ltx_Math" alttext="r=\mathsf{confirm}" display="inline"><mrow><mi>r</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>𝖼𝗈𝗇𝖿𝗂𝗋𝗆</mi></mrow></math> if it succeeds and <math id="S4.I1.i1.p1.m15" class="ltx_Math" alttext="r=\mathsf{fail}" display="inline"><mrow><mi>r</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>𝖿𝖺𝗂𝗅</mi></mrow></math> otherwise.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li id="S4.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"><math id="S4.I1.i2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\blacksquare" display="inline"><mi mathvariant="normal">■</mi></math></span> 
<div id="S4.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p"><math id="S4.I1.i2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\textit{balance}_{u}()/v_{u}" display="inline"><mrow><mrow><msub><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_italic">balance</mtext><mi>u</mi></msub><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>/</mo><msub><mi>v</mi><mi>u</mi></msub></mrow></math> takes no inputs and returns the value <math id="S4.I1.i2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="v_{u}" display="inline"><msub><mi>v</mi><mi>u</mi></msub></math> stored at location <math id="S4.I1.i2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="u" display="inline"><mi>u</mi></math> of the state <math id="S4.I1.i2.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="[v_{k}]_{k=1}^{U}" display="inline"><msubsup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msub><mi>v</mi><mi>k</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>U</mi></msubsup></math>.</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">Let <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{O}" display="inline"><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒪</mi></math> be a set of FPAT <em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">operations</em> – invocations of <span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">transfer</span> and <span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">balances</span> provided with matching responses, each associated with a distinct user.
Let <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\textit{transfer}_{u}(*,*)/C" display="inline"><mrow><mrow><msub><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_italic">transfer</mtext><mi>u</mi></msub><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">∗</mo><mo rspace="0em">,</mo><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">∗</mo><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>/</mo><mi>C</mi></mrow></math> (resp., <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\textit{transfer}_{u}(*,*)/F" display="inline"><mrow><mrow><msub><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_italic">transfer</mtext><mi>u</mi></msub><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">∗</mo><mo rspace="0em">,</mo><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">∗</mo><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>/</mo><mi>F</mi></mrow></math>) denotes a transfer operation invoked by a user <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p2.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="u" display="inline"><mi>u</mi></math> that returns <span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">confirm</span> (resp. <span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">fail</span>).
For each user <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p2.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="u" display="inline"><mi>u</mi></math>, we define a function <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p2.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\textit{total}_{i}(\mathcal{O})" display="inline"><mrow><msub><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_italic">total</mtext><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒪</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> as follows:</p>
<table id="S4.Ex1" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_left_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_left"><math id="S4.Ex1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\textit{total}_{u}(\mathcal{O})=v^{init}_{u}+\sum_{\begin{subarray}{c}\textit{%
transfer}_{*}(v,u)/C\end{subarray}\in\mathcal{O}}v\;\;\;-\sum_{\textit{%
transfer}_{u}(v,*)/C\in\mathcal{O}}v" display="block"><mrow><mrow><msub><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_italic">total</mtext><mi>u</mi></msub><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒪</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><msubsup><mi>v</mi><mi>u</mi><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>i</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>t</mi></mrow></msubsup><mo rspace="0.055em">+</mo><mrow><munder><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mtable><mtr><mtd><mrow><mrow><msub><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_italic">transfer</mtext><mo>∗</mo></msub><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>u</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>/</mo><mi>C</mi></mrow></mtd></mtr></mtable><mo>∈</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒪</mi></mrow></munder><mi>v</mi></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="1.052em" rspace="0.055em">−</mo><mrow><munder><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_italic">transfer</mtext><mi>u</mi></msub><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo rspace="0em">,</mo><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">∗</mo><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>/</mo><mi>C</mi></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒪</mi></mrow></munder><mi>v</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_left_padright"></td>
</tr></tbody>
</table>
<p class="ltx_p"><math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p2.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\textit{total}_{u}(\mathcal{O})" display="inline"><mrow><msub><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_italic">total</mtext><mi>u</mi></msub><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒪</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> is thus defined as the current <span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">balance</span> of <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p2.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="u" display="inline"><mi>u</mi></math> after all successful transfers in <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p2.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{O}" display="inline"><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒪</mi></math> complete: the initial amount owned by <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p2.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="u" display="inline"><mi>u</mi></math>, minus all the funds sent by <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p2.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="u" display="inline"><mi>u</mi></math> plus all the funds received by <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p2.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="u" display="inline"><mi>u</mi></math> in the set of operation <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p2.m13" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{O}" display="inline"><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒪</mi></math>.</p>
</div>
<div id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">A <em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">sequential history</em> <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="S" display="inline"><mi>S</mi></math> (of FPAT) is a totally ordered set of FPAT operations, let <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p3.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\prec_{S}" display="inline"><msub><mo>≺</mo><mi>S</mi></msub></math> be this order.
Let <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p3.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="S|_{u}" display="inline"><msub><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mi>u</mi></msub></math> denotes the sub-sequence of <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p3.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="S" display="inline"><mi>S</mi></math> consisting of the events of user <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p3.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="u" display="inline"><mi>u</mi></math>.
We say that <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p3.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="S" display="inline"><mi>S</mi></math> is <em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">legal</em> if:</p>
<ol id="S4.I2" class="ltx_enumerate">
<li id="S4.I2.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">1.</span> 
<div id="S4.I2.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p"><math id="S4.I2.i1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\forall o=transfer_{u}(v,w)/C\in S\quad v\leq total_{u}(\{o^{\prime}\in S:o^{%
\prime}\prec_{S}o\})" display="inline"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo rspace="0.167em">∀</mo><mi>o</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>r</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>s</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>f</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>e</mi><mo>⁢</mo><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>u</mi></msub><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>w</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>/</mo><mi>C</mi></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mi>S</mi></mrow><mspace style="width:1em;" width="1em"></mspace><mrow><mi>v</mi><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>o</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>t</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>⁢</mo><msub><mi>l</mi><mi>u</mi></msub><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><mrow><msup><mi>o</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo>∈</mo><mi>S</mi></mrow><mo lspace="0.278em" rspace="0.278em">:</mo><mrow><msup><mi>o</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><msub><mo>≺</mo><mi>S</mi></msub><mi>o</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></p>
</div>
</li>
<li id="S4.I2.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">2.</span> 
<div id="S4.I2.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p"><math id="S4.I2.i2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\forall o=balance_{u}()/v\in S\quad v\leq total_{u}(\{o^{\prime}\in S:o^{%
\prime}\prec_{S}o\})" display="inline"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo rspace="0.167em">∀</mo><mi>o</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>b</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>l</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>⁢</mo><msub><mi>e</mi><mi>u</mi></msub><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>/</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mi>S</mi></mrow><mspace style="width:1em;" width="1em"></mspace><mrow><mi>v</mi><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>o</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>t</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>⁢</mo><msub><mi>l</mi><mi>u</mi></msub><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><mrow><msup><mi>o</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo>∈</mo><mi>S</mi></mrow><mo lspace="0.278em" rspace="0.278em">:</mo><mrow><msup><mi>o</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><msub><mo>≺</mo><mi>S</mi></msub><mi>o</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></p>
</div>
</li>
<li id="S4.I2.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">3.</span> 
<div id="S4.I2.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">If an operation <math id="S4.I2.i3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\textit{balance}_{u}()" display="inline"><mrow><msub><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_italic">balance</mtext><mi>u</mi></msub><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> returning <math id="S4.I2.i3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="v_{1}" display="inline"><msub><mi>v</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></math> directly precedes a <math id="S4.I2.i3.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\textit{transfer}_{u}(v_{2},w)" display="inline"><mrow><msub><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_italic">transfer</mtext><mi>u</mi></msub><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>v</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mi>w</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> operation in <math id="S4.I2.i3.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="S|_{u}" display="inline"><msub><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mi>u</mi></msub></math>, and <math id="S4.I2.i3.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="v_{2}\leq v_{1}" display="inline"><mrow><msub><mi>v</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>≤</mo><msub><mi>v</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow></math>, then the transfer operation cannot return <math id="S4.I2.i3.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathsf{fail}" display="inline"><mi>𝖿𝖺𝗂𝗅</mi></math>.</p>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</section>
<section id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2" class="ltx_subparagraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subparagraph">Histories and serializations.</h4>

<div id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">Consider an <em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">execution</em> of a FPAT algorithm: a sequence of <em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">events</em> produced by the algorithm, such as invocations and responses of FPAT operations, sending and receiving messages, etc.
A <em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">local history</em> <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="L_{i}" display="inline"><msub><mi>L</mi><mi>i</mi></msub></math> of a user <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="i" display="inline"><mi>i</mi></math> is the sequence of <em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">operations</em> invoked by <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="i" display="inline"><mi>i</mi></math> in that execution.
We assume that correct users are <em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">well-formed</em> – they never invoke a new operation before the previous one returns, and thus if <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="u" display="inline"><mi>u</mi></math> is correct, then <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="L_{u}" display="inline"><msub><mi>L</mi><mi>u</mi></msub></math> is sequential.
In case the last operation of <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="L_{u}" display="inline"><msub><mi>L</mi><mi>u</mi></msub></math> is <em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">incomplete</em> (not followed by a response), we can add any matching response and get a <em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">completion</em> of <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="L_{u}" display="inline"><msub><mi>L</mi><mi>u</mi></msub></math>.
Now a <em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">history</em> <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="H" display="inline"><mi>H</mi></math> is a vector <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2.p1.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(L_{1},L_{2},...,L_{|\mathcal{U}|})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>L</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>L</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>L</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒰</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> of local histories, one for each user.
Notice that if the history is produced by an execution of a FPAT algorithm, only the local histories of correct users are of interest for us: a Byzantine user is not obliged to follow the protocol.</p>
</div>
<div id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">A sequential (FPAT) history <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="S" display="inline"><mi>S</mi></math> is a <em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">serialization</em> of a history <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="H=(L_{1},L_{2},...,L_{|\mathcal{U}|})" display="inline"><mrow><mi>H</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>L</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>L</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>L</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒰</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> if
for each <em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">correct</em> user <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2.p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="u" display="inline"><mi>u</mi></math>, there exists <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2.p2.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\hat{L}_{u}" display="inline"><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>L</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>u</mi></msub></math>, a completion of <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2.p2.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="L_{u}" display="inline"><msub><mi>L</mi><mi>u</mi></msub></math>, such that <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2.p2.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="S|_{u}=\hat{L}_{u}" display="inline"><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mi>u</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>L</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>u</mi></msub></mrow></math>
(<math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2.p2.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\prec_{S}" display="inline"><msub><mo>≺</mo><mi>S</mi></msub></math> respects the local order <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2.p2.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\prec_{\hat{L}_{u}}" display="inline"><msub><mo>≺</mo><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>L</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>u</mi></msub></msub></math>).
<math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2.p2.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="S" display="inline"><mi>S</mi></math> can be seen as a <em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">global interpretation</em> of the local histories of correct users.
Notice that we allow any operations to be executed by Byzantine users in <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2.p2.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="S" display="inline"><mi>S</mi></math>, as long as it “makes sense” to the correct ones.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx3" class="ltx_subparagraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subparagraph">FPAT-Safety.</h4>

<div id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">An implementation of a FPAT-object is <span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">FPAT-Safe</span> if and only if, for any finite history of execution <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="H" display="inline"><mi>H</mi></math> it produces, there exists a serialization <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="S" display="inline"><mi>S</mi></math> of <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx3.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="H" display="inline"><mi>H</mi></math> which is legal.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx4" class="ltx_subparagraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subparagraph">FPAT-Liveness.</h4>

<div id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">Liveness ensures that (1) every operation invoked by a correct user eventually completes and (2) considering two correct users <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx4.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="u" display="inline"><mi>u</mi></math> and <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx4.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="w" display="inline"><mi>w</mi></math>, if <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx4.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="w" display="inline"><mi>w</mi></math> transfers money to <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx4.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="u" display="inline"><mi>u</mi></math>, then <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx4.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="u" display="inline"><mi>u</mi></math> eventually receives this money.
Let us consider the existence of a global time during the execution of an implemented FPAT object.
An implementation of a FPAT-object is <span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">FPAT-Live</span> if:</p>
<ol id="S4.I3" class="ltx_enumerate">
<li id="S4.I3.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">1.</span> 
<div id="S4.I3.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">All <span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">transfer</span> and <span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">balance</span> operations terminate for correct users.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li id="S4.I3.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">2.</span> 
<div id="S4.I3.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">Consider a correct user <math id="S4.I3.i2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="u" display="inline"><mi>u</mi></math>. For each operation <math id="S4.I3.i2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\textit{transfer}_{*}(*,u)" display="inline"><mrow><msub><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_italic">transfer</mtext><mo>∗</mo></msub><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">∗</mo><mo>,</mo><mi>u</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> completed during the execution at time <math id="S4.I3.i2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t" display="inline"><mi>t</mi></math>, there exists a time <math id="S4.I3.i2.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t^{\prime}\geq t" display="inline"><mrow><msup><mi>t</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo>≥</mo><mi>t</mi></mrow></math> such that any operation <span class="ltx_text ltx_markedasmath ltx_font_italic">balance</span> inserted at time <math id="S4.I3.i2.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t^{\prime\prime}\geq t^{\prime}" display="inline"><mrow><msup><mi>t</mi><mo>′′</mo></msup><mo>≥</mo><msup><mi>t</mi><mo>′</mo></msup></mrow></math> will return a value <math id="S4.I3.i2.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="v" display="inline"><mi>v</mi></math> such that:</p>
<table id="S4.Ex2" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_left_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_left"><math id="S4.Ex2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="v\geq\sum_{\begin{subarray}{c}\textit{transfer}_{*}(v_{+},u)\\
\text{invoked by correct users}\\
\text{completed before time }t\end{subarray}}{v_{+}}\;\;-\sum_{\begin{subarray%
}{c}\textit{transfer}_{u}(v_{-},*)\\
\text{completed before time }t^{\prime\prime}\end{subarray}}{v_{-}}" display="block"><mrow><mi>v</mi><mo rspace="0.111em">≥</mo><mrow><mrow><munder><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mtable rowspacing="0pt"><mtr><mtd><mrow><msub><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_italic">transfer</mtext><mo>∗</mo></msub><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>v</mi><mo>+</mo></msub><mo>,</mo><mi>u</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mtext>invoked by correct users</mtext></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mrow><mtext>completed before time </mtext><mo>⁢</mo><mi>t</mi></mrow></mtd></mtr></mtable></munder><msub><mi>v</mi><mo>+</mo></msub></mrow><mo rspace="0.055em">−</mo><mrow><munder><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mtable rowspacing="0pt"><mtr><mtd><mrow><msub><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_italic">transfer</mtext><mi>u</mi></msub><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>v</mi><mo>−</mo></msub><mo rspace="0em">,</mo><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">∗</mo><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mrow><mtext>completed before time </mtext><mo>⁢</mo><msup><mi>t</mi><mo>′′</mo></msup></mrow></mtd></mtr></mtable></munder><msub><mi>v</mi><mo>−</mo></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_left_padright"></td>
</tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</section>
<section id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5" class="ltx_subparagraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subparagraph">FPAT-privacy.</h4>

<div id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">We capture the privacy guarantees of FPAT through a <em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">distinguishing game</em> <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{G}^{priv}" display="inline"><msup><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒢</mi><mrow><mi>p</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>r</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>i</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow></msup></math> described in details the full version of the paper.
<em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">FPAT-privacy</em> has important implications that can be expressed as a collection of properties we use here.
Let <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\epsilon" display="inline"><mi>ϵ</mi></math> be a negligible function and <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\lambda" display="inline"><mi>λ</mi></math> the security parameter.
Consider a protocol execution, let <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="H" display="inline"><mi>H</mi></math> be its history and <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{U}_{Byz}" display="inline"><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒰</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>z</mi></mrow></msub></math> the set of users controlled by the adversary, among the <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="U" display="inline"><mi>U</mi></math> users of the system.
Let <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="o=\textit{transfer}_{u}(v,w)\in H" display="inline"><mrow><mi>o</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_italic">transfer</mtext><mi>u</mi></msub><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>w</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mi>H</mi></mrow></math> be any <span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">transfer</span> operation such that <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="u" display="inline"><mi>u</mi></math> is honest.
Then for each guess <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(u^{\prime},v^{\prime},w^{\prime})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>u</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>v</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>w</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> made by an adversary with no prior knowledge, where <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="u^{\prime}" display="inline"><msup><mi>u</mi><mo>′</mo></msup></math> is the payment sender, <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="v^{\prime}" display="inline"><msup><mi>v</mi><mo>′</mo></msup></math> is the value, and <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="w^{\prime}" display="inline"><msup><mi>w</mi><mo>′</mo></msup></math> is the payment recipient, the following properties hold:</p>
<ol id="S4.I4" class="ltx_enumerate">
<li id="S4.I4.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">1.</span> 
<div id="S4.I4.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p"><span class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Sender-anonymity</span>: <math id="S4.I4.i1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbb{P}(u^{\prime}=u)\leq\frac{1}{U-|\mathcal{U}_{Byz}|}+\epsilon(\lambda)" display="inline"><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">ℙ</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>u</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo>=</mo><mi>u</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mi>U</mi><mo>−</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒰</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>z</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow></mrow></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mrow><mi>ϵ</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>λ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></math>, i.e., the adversary only knows that the sender is not itself.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li id="S4.I4.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">2.</span> 
<div id="S4.I4.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p"><span class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Receiver-anonymity</span>: If <math id="S4.I4.i2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="w" display="inline"><mi>w</mi></math> is honest, then <math id="S4.I4.i2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbb{P}(w^{\prime}=w)\leq\frac{1}{U-|\mathcal{U}_{Byz}|}+\epsilon(\lambda)" display="inline"><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">ℙ</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>w</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo>=</mo><mi>w</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mi>U</mi><mo>−</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒰</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>z</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow></mrow></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mrow><mi>ϵ</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>λ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></math>, i.e., the adversary only knows that the receiver is not itself.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li id="S4.I4.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">3.</span> 
<div id="S4.I4.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p"><span class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Confidentiality</span>: If <math id="S4.I4.i3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="w" display="inline"><mi>w</mi></math> is honest, then <math id="S4.I4.i3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbb{P}(v^{\prime}=v)\leq\epsilon(\lambda)" display="inline"><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">ℙ</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>v</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo>=</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mi>ϵ</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>λ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></math>, i.e.,the adversary cannot guess the amount of the transaction.</p>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
<p class="ltx_p">These three properties together constitute <span class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">full privacy</span>.
Additionally, <span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">FPAT-privacy</span>, as captured by the <em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">distinguishing game</em> <math id="S4.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1.m13" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{G}^{priv}" display="inline"><msup><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒢</mi><mrow><mi>p</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>r</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>i</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow></msup></math>, implies <span class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">unlinkability</span>: given two transfers, no adversary can determine whether the sender, receiver, or amount is the same in both transfers.</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="S5" class="ltx_section">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_section">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_section">5 </span>PaxPay Protocol</h2>

<div id="S5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">We overview our FPAT implementation below and delegate detailed algorithms and proofs of correctness to the full version of the paper.</p>
</div>
<section id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1" class="ltx_subparagraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subparagraph">Setup.</h4>

<div id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">Every user is identified by her public address <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="apk" display="inline"><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>p</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></math> that is derived from a secret address <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="ask" display="inline"><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>s</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></math> as follows: <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="apk=PRF_{ask}(0)" display="inline"><mrow><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>p</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>P</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>R</mi><mo>⁢</mo><msub><mi>F</mi><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>s</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></math>
<span id="footnote4" class="ltx_note ltx_role_footnote"><sup class="ltx_note_mark">4</sup><span class="ltx_note_outer"><span class="ltx_note_content"><sup class="ltx_note_mark">4</sup><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_note">4</span>The address generation is detailed in <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib11" title="" class="ltx_ref">11</a>]</cite> and shows the address generation process by sampling a random <math id="footnote4.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="ask" display="inline"><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>s</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></math> and deriving the <math id="footnote4.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="apk" display="inline"><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>p</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></math>.</span></span></span></p>
</div>
<div id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">The protocol uses a (<math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="2f+1" display="inline"><mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>⁢</mo><mi>f</mi></mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math>, <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="N" display="inline"><mi>N</mi></math>)-threshold blind signature scheme, as defined in Section <a href="#S3.SS3" title="3.3 Cryptographic tools ‣ 3 Model ‣ Fast, Private and Regulated Payments in Asynchronous Networks" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">3.3</span></a>. The secret signing keys <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="[sk_{i}]_{i=1}^{N}" display="inline"><msubsup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>⁢</mo><msub><mi>k</mi><mi>i</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>N</mi></msubsup></math> are held by each of the validators. The aggregated public key is denoted by <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p2.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="pk_{agg}" display="inline"><mrow><mi>p</mi><mo>⁢</mo><msub><mi>k</mi><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>g</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>g</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></math>
The protocol will also make use of NIZK, as defined in Section <a href="#S3.SS3" title="3.3 Cryptographic tools ‣ 3 Model ‣ Fast, Private and Regulated Payments in Asynchronous Networks" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">3.3</span></a>. The setup algorithms for these primitives are again described in <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib11" title="" class="ltx_ref">11</a>]</cite>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2" class="ltx_subparagraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subparagraph">Coin structure.</h4>

<div id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">A <em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">coin</em> is a tuple <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\textbf{c}=(v,apk,\rho)" display="inline"><mrow><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_bold">c</mtext><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>p</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow><mo>,</mo><mi>ρ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> with:</p>
<ul id="S5.I1" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="S5.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"><math id="S5.I1.i1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\blacksquare" display="inline"><mi mathvariant="normal">■</mi></math></span> 
<div id="S5.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p"><math id="S5.I1.i1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="v" display="inline"><mi>v</mi></math> the (integer) value of the coin.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li id="S5.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"><math id="S5.I1.i2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\blacksquare" display="inline"><mi mathvariant="normal">■</mi></math></span> 
<div id="S5.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p"><math id="S5.I1.i2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="apk" display="inline"><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>p</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></math> the public address of the owner of the coin.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li id="S5.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"><math id="S5.I1.i3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\blacksquare" display="inline"><mi mathvariant="normal">■</mi></math></span> 
<div id="S5.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p"><math id="S5.I1.i3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\rho" display="inline"><mi>ρ</mi></math> the seed of the coin, from which the serial number is derived.</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="ltx_p">Coins are similar to unspent transactions (UTXO) in Bitcoin: to make a payment, a user “spends” <em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">old</em> coins and creates <em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">new</em> coins whose owners are the payment recipients.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx3" class="ltx_subparagraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subparagraph">Coin validity.</h4>

<div id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">Using a quorum of validators signatures (inspired by Byzantine Consistent Broadcast), we decide whether a coin is valid or not. In concrete terms, a coin is valid if it has been signed by <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="2f+1" display="inline"><mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>⁢</mo><mi>f</mi></mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> validators.
During a transfer, several old coins <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="[\textbf{c}_{i}^{old}]_{i\in[1,n]}" display="inline"><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msubsup><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_bold">c</mtext><mi>i</mi><mrow><mi>o</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>l</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></msubsup><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mi>n</mi><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow></msub></math> are spent to create new coins <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx3.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="[\textbf{c}_{j}^{new}]_{j\in[1,m]}" display="inline"><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msubsup><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_bold">c</mtext><mi>j</mi><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>e</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>w</mi></mrow></msubsup><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mi>m</mi><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow></msub></math>.
To make sure that a coin it not spent twice, a unique <em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">serial number</em> is derived from the coin’s seed <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx3.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\rho" display="inline"><mi>ρ</mi></math> as <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx3.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="sn=\textsf{PRF}_{ask}(\rho)" display="inline"><mrow><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>n</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_sans-serif">PRF</mtext><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>s</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></msub><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>ρ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></math>.
Each validator maintains a list <span class="ltx_text ltx_font_sansserif">snList</span> of the old coins’ serial numbers.
The coins <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx3.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="[\textbf{c}_{i}^{old}]_{i\in[1,n]}" display="inline"><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msubsup><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_bold">c</mtext><mi>i</mi><mrow><mi>o</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>l</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></msubsup><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mi>n</mi><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow></msub></math> are considered spent when a quorum of <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx3.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="2f+1" display="inline"><mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>⁢</mo><mi>f</mi></mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> validators have appended the corresponding serial numbers <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx3.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="[sn_{i}^{old}]_{i\in[1,n]}" display="inline"><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>⁢</mo><msubsup><mi>n</mi><mi>i</mi><mrow><mi>o</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>l</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></msubsup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mi>n</mi><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow></msub></math> to their <span class="ltx_text ltx_font_sansserif">snList</span>.</p>
</div>
<div id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx3.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">Intuitively, as the computation of <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx3.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="sn_{i}^{old}" display="inline"><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>⁢</mo><msubsup><mi>n</mi><mi>i</mi><mrow><mi>o</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>l</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></msubsup></mrow></math> is using the <span class="ltx_text ltx_font_sansserif">PRF</span> and the secret address of the payer, no party can link <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx3.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="sn_{i}^{old}" display="inline"><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>⁢</mo><msubsup><mi>n</mi><mi>i</mi><mrow><mi>o</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>l</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></msubsup></mrow></math> to <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx3.p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\rho_{i}^{old}" display="inline"><msubsup><mi>ρ</mi><mi>i</mi><mrow><mi>o</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>l</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></msubsup></math> or <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx3.p2.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="apk_{i}^{old}" display="inline"><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>p</mi><mo>⁢</mo><msubsup><mi>k</mi><mi>i</mi><mrow><mi>o</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>l</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></msubsup></mrow></math>, and thus the sender-anonymity property is preserved.
The full version of the paper details an algorithm that initializes the balances for the initial set of users, by creating coins for each of them.<span id="footnote5" class="ltx_note ltx_role_footnote"><sup class="ltx_note_mark">5</sup><span class="ltx_note_outer"><span class="ltx_note_content"><sup class="ltx_note_mark">5</sup><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_note">5</span>As discussed in Section <a href="#S8" title="8 Discussion and comparison with related protocols ‣ Fast, Private and Regulated Payments in Asynchronous Networks" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">8</span></a>, depending on the use cases of the system, this algorithm might not be executed. Instead, users might freely join the system and call a <span class="ltx_text ltx_font_sansserif">Mint</span> algorithm that provides them with new coins.</span></span></span></p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx4" class="ltx_subparagraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subparagraph">Local variables.</h4>

<div id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">User storage consists of:</p>
<ul id="S5.I2" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="S5.I2.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"><math id="S5.I2.i1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\blacksquare" display="inline"><mi mathvariant="normal">■</mi></math></span> 
<div id="S5.I2.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p"><math id="S5.I2.i1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="apk/ask" display="inline"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>p</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow><mo>/</mo><mi>a</mi></mrow><mo>⁢</mo><mi>s</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></math>: its public/secret address pair</p>
</div>
</li>
<li id="S5.I2.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"><math id="S5.I2.i2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\blacksquare" display="inline"><mi mathvariant="normal">■</mi></math></span> 
<div id="S5.I2.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p"><math id="S5.I2.i2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathsf{coinList}=[(\textbf{c}_{i},\sigma_{i})]_{i}" display="inline"><mrow><mi>𝖼𝗈𝗂𝗇𝖫𝗂𝗌𝗍</mi><mo>=</mo><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mtext class="ltx_mathvariant_bold">c</mtext><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mi>i</mi></msub></mrow></math>: the set of coins owned by the user associated with the aggregated signature of each coin.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li id="S5.I2.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"><math id="S5.I2.i3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\blacksquare" display="inline"><mi mathvariant="normal">■</mi></math></span> 
<div id="S5.I2.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p"><math id="S5.I2.i3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathsf{rhoList}" display="inline"><mi>𝗋𝗁𝗈𝖫𝗂𝗌𝗍</mi></math>: the list of all seed <math id="S5.I2.i3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\rho" display="inline"><mi>ρ</mi></math> corresponding to coins received by the user</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="ltx_p">Validator storage consists of:</p>
<ul id="S5.I3" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="S5.I3.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"><math id="S5.I3.i1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\blacksquare" display="inline"><mi mathvariant="normal">■</mi></math></span> 
<div id="S5.I3.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p"><math id="S5.I3.i1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="sk" display="inline"><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></math>: its secret signing key</p>
</div>
</li>
<li id="S5.I3.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"><math id="S5.I3.i2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\blacksquare" display="inline"><mi mathvariant="normal">■</mi></math></span> 
<div id="S5.I3.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p"><math id="S5.I3.i2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathsf{snList}" display="inline"><mi>𝗌𝗇𝖫𝗂𝗌𝗍</mi></math>: the list of serial numbers identifying spent coins.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li id="S5.I3.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item"><math id="S5.I3.i3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\blacksquare" display="inline"><mi mathvariant="normal">■</mi></math></span> 
<div id="S5.I3.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p"><math id="S5.I3.i3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathsf{signedCoinList}" display="inline"><mi>𝗌𝗂𝗀𝗇𝖾𝖽𝖢𝗈𝗂𝗇𝖫𝗂𝗌𝗍</mi></math>: the list of all blinded coins signed by the replica.</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</section>
<section id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5" class="ltx_subparagraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subparagraph">Transfer.</h4>

<div id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">Assuming a user has enough funds, she can issue payments to several recipients <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="[{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,1}apk_{j}^{%
new}}]_{j=1}^{m}" display="inline"><msubsup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">a</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">p</mi><mo>⁢</mo><msubsup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">k</mi><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">j</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">n</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">e</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">w</mi></mrow></msubsup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>m</mi></msubsup></math> in one transfer by sending <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,1}v_{j}^{new}}" display="inline"><msubsup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">v</mi><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">j</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">n</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">e</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">w</mi></mrow></msubsup></math> to <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,1}apk_{j}^{new}}" display="inline"><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">a</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">p</mi><mo>⁢</mo><msubsup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">k</mi><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">j</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">n</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">e</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">w</mi></mrow></msubsup></mrow></math>.
The full algorithm is described in <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib11" title="" class="ltx_ref">11</a>]</cite>.
The user first chooses <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n" display="inline"><mi>n</mi></math> (old) coins denoted <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="[{\color[rgb]{.75,0,.25}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{.75,0,.25}%
\mathbf{c}^{old}_{i}}]_{i=1}^{n}" display="inline"><msubsup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msubsup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">𝐜</mi><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">i</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">o</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">l</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">d</mi></mrow></msubsup><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>n</mi></msubsup></math> and their signatures <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="[{\color[rgb]{.75,0,.25}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{.75,0,.25}%
\sigma^{old}_{i}}]_{i=1}^{n}" display="inline"><msubsup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msubsup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">σ</mi><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">i</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">o</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">l</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">d</mi></mrow></msubsup><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>n</mi></msubsup></math> from her <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathsf{coinList}" display="inline"><mi>𝖼𝗈𝗂𝗇𝖫𝗂𝗌𝗍</mi></math>,
where <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="{\color[rgb]{.75,0,.25}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{.75,0,.25}%
\mathbf{c}^{old}_{i}=(v^{old}_{i},apk^{old}_{i},\rho^{old}_{i})}" display="inline"><mrow><msubsup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">𝐜</mi><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">i</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">o</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">l</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">d</mi></mrow></msubsup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">=</mo><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040" stretchy="false">(</mo><msubsup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">v</mi><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">i</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">o</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">l</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">d</mi></mrow></msubsup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">,</mo><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">a</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">p</mi><mo>⁢</mo><msubsup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">k</mi><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">i</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">o</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">l</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">d</mi></mrow></msubsup></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">,</mo><msubsup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">ρ</mi><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">i</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">o</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">l</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">d</mi></mrow></msubsup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></math>,
such that the total value of the old coins does not fall below the total value payed in the transfer: <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sum_{i=1}^{n}{{\color[rgb]{.75,0,.25}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}%
{.75,0,.25}v^{old}_{i}}}\geq\sum_{j=1}^{m}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\definecolor[%
named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,1}v^{new}_{j}}}" display="inline"><mrow><mrow><msubsup><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>n</mi></msubsup><msubsup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">v</mi><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">i</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">o</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">l</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">d</mi></mrow></msubsup></mrow><mo rspace="0.111em">≥</mo><mrow><msubsup><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>m</mi></msubsup><msubsup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">v</mi><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">j</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">n</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">e</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">w</mi></mrow></msubsup></mrow></mrow></math>.
(Otherwise, the transfer operation returns <span class="ltx_text ltx_font_sansserif">fail</span>.)
The user then computes the serial number <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="[{\color[rgb]{.75,0,.25}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{.75,0,.25}sn_%
{i}^{old}}]_{i=1}^{n}" display="inline"><msubsup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">s</mi><mo>⁢</mo><msubsup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">n</mi><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">i</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">o</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">l</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">d</mi></mrow></msubsup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>n</mi></msubsup></math> of every old coin as follows:
<math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p1.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="{\color[rgb]{.75,0,.25}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{.75,0,.25}sn_{%
i}^{old}}=\mathsf{PRF}_{{\color[rgb]{.75,0,.25}\definecolor[named]{%
pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{.75,0,.25}ask_{i}^{old}}}({\color[rgb]{.75,0,.25}%
\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{.75,0,.25}\rho_{i}^{old}})" display="inline"><mrow><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">s</mi><mo>⁢</mo><msubsup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">n</mi><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">i</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">o</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">l</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">d</mi></mrow></msubsup></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝖯𝖱𝖥</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">a</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">s</mi><mo>⁢</mo><msubsup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">k</mi><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">i</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">o</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">l</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">d</mi></mrow></msubsup></mrow></msub><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msubsup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">ρ</mi><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">i</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">o</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">l</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">d</mi></mrow></msubsup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></math>.</p>
</div>
<div id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">The <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="j" display="inline"><mi>j</mi></math> new coins are then produced by the user according to the values and addresses to pay: <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\forall j\in[1,m]" display="inline"><mrow><mrow><mo rspace="0.167em">∀</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mi>m</mi><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow></math>, <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,1}\mathbf{c}^{%
new}_{j}=(v^{new}_{j},apk^{new}_{j},\rho^{new}_{j})}" display="inline"><mrow><msubsup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">𝐜</mi><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">j</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">n</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">e</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">w</mi></mrow></msubsup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">=</mo><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF" stretchy="false">(</mo><msubsup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">v</mi><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">j</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">n</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">e</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">w</mi></mrow></msubsup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">,</mo><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">a</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">p</mi><mo>⁢</mo><msubsup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">k</mi><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">j</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">n</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">e</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">w</mi></mrow></msubsup></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">,</mo><msubsup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">ρ</mi><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">j</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">n</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">e</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">w</mi></mrow></msubsup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></math>.
<math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p2.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,1}\rho^{new}_{%
j}}" display="inline"><msubsup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">ρ</mi><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">j</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">n</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">e</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">w</mi></mrow></msubsup></math> is derived as <math id="S5.SS0.SSS0.P0.SPx5.p2.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,1}\rho^{new}_{%
j}}=\mathsf{PRF}_{\rho_{seed}}({\color[rgb]{.75,0,.25}\definecolor[named]{%
pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{.75,0,.25}sn_{1}^{old}}||...||{\color[rgb]{.75,0,.25}%
\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{.75,0,.25}sn_{n}^{old}}||j)" display="inline"><mrow><msubsup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">ρ</mi><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">j</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">n</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">e</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#0000FF;" mathcolor="#0000FF">w</mi></mrow></msubsup><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝖯𝖱𝖥</mi><msub><mi>ρ</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>e</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>e</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></msub></msub><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">s</mi><mo>⁢</mo><msubsup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#BF0040;" mathcolor="#BF0040">n</mi><mn
